# FirstFound

> FirstFound is a Dutch consultancy for AI visibility, also called GEO
> or generative engine optimisation. We measure whether a company is
> named when AI systems answer buying questions in its market, and we
> improve the signals those systems read. Based in Groningen, the
> Netherlands; the site is one page, in Dutch and English.

Search is changing from a list of links into a generated answer. A
company is either part of that answer or it is not. FirstFound is the
measuring and the work that follows from it: no guarantees of being
named by any particular model, because nobody can honestly offer that.

## What we do

- [AI Visibility](https://firstfound.nl/#diensten): measure how and
  where a brand appears across AI systems, with competitors alongside.
- [GEO strategy](https://firstfound.nl/#diensten): improve the signals
  that decide whether a brand becomes part of the answer.
- [Authority and content](https://firstfound.nl/#diensten): strengthen
  the information ecosystem around a brand, on its own site and on the
  sources AI systems actually cite.
- [Monitoring](https://firstfound.nl/#diensten): track how AI platforms
  represent a company over time, and alert when the picture shifts.

## How it works

- [The shift](https://firstfound.nl/#verschuiving): what changes when a
  search engine becomes an answer engine.
- [What GEO is](https://firstfound.nl/#geo): an AI system does not pick
  the highest-ranked page; it assembles an answer from signals it
  trusts. GEO is the work of putting those signals in order.
- [Method](https://firstfound.nl/#werkwijze): measure, then write.
  Analysis, strategy, optimisation, monitoring.
- [Engagement](https://firstfound.nl/#pakketten): a one-off setup,
  after which a monthly package keeps the visibility current.

## Tools

- [Visibility scan](https://firstfound.nl/#index): a free technical
  scan of a site, read the way an AI crawler reads it. It measures
  access, structure, entity clarity and answerability on the site
  itself. It does not query any AI model and does not report what a
  model says about a company.

## About

- [About FirstFound](https://firstfound.nl/#over): GEO is young, which
  is exactly why specialisation matters. There is no handbook, only
  measuring, interpreting and adjusting.
- [FAQ](https://firstfound.nl/#faq)
